content: ABRAHAM-MILI WARINYARRANGU PARTANYKARRANGU (25:1-6)
Abraham-ju purlpi yiji mana wariny mirtawa, yaru. Palinymili yini Keturah.
Kanyapulujaninyi 6 pirirrimarta, pulanymili partanykarrangu: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.
Jokshan japartu jarrinyi Sheba-kupa Dedan-ku. Dedan japartu jarrinyijanaku Ashurites-kupa Letushites-kupa Leummites-ku.
Midian-mili partanykarrangu Ephah-pa Epher-pa Hanok-pa Abida-pa Eldaah. Palarrangu wiyirr Keturah-mili.

Palangangarra wirtu jarrinyiyi. Abraham-ju yinyajaninyi wurrukarra, palaja ngakarnajaninyi warinykarti warrarnkarti, kakarra, Isaac-ngamarra ngakarnajaninyi. Palaja wurrukarra jinta wiyirr palinymili yinyali Isaac, wurrukarra palinymili ngani warralpirti.
ABRAHAM MARLKARRI JARRINYI (25:7-11)
Abraham partunurrangu-partunurrangu waninyi, 175-ja. Palaja mirtanya jarrinyaja marlkarri jarrinyi.

Palinymili partanyjujirri Isaac-jupa Ishmael-ju wirrirnipulu pulanymili japartu jurntingi kaninykurti, Machpelah-nga. Purlpi palangarra jurnti waninyikinyalu warinymili. Abraham-ju mana warnkulu, warnkurrangu marlu yinyala Ephron palaku jurntikupa jungkaku. Purlpi marlkarri jarrinyaja palinymili mirtawa, Sarah, Abraham-ju wirrirni palanga jurntingi. Palangangarra jurntingi kuwarri palinymilalujirri partanyjujirri wirrirnipulu paliny pukun.
Palaja Ngarrkalu tuku jirnikinyi Isaac. Isaac-ju ngurra jirni yintanga, ngapingi, Lahai-Roi-ngi.
ISHMAEL-MILI NYIRRIRNIKARTIJARRANGU (25:12-18)
Purlpi Abraham karta karrinyipulu Hagar, warrkamukata Egypt-ja Sarah-mili. Hagar-lu partany kanya, Ishmael.
Ishmael japartu jarrinyijanaku pirirri partanykarrangu: Nebaioth, Kedar, Abdeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massah,
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, Kedemah
Palarrangumili nyirrinikartijarrangu 12 tribes, yini janamili yinyayi tawunkurrangupa ngurrarrangu.
Ishmael 137 partunurrangu jarrinyaja, marlkarri jarrinyi.
Ishmael-mili nyirrirnikartijarrangu warrarnja waninyayi Havilah-nga partijirri Shur-nga. Pala warrarn egypt-ja kakarrakurnu, Assyria-karti. Kaja waninyayi Abraham-milirrangu nyirrirnikarijarrangu.
WURRALAMARNANGU ISAAC (25:19-20)
Nyungu muwarr Isaac-mili, partany Abraham-mili.
Isaac 40 partunurrangu jarrinyaja mirtawaku kanya Rebecca, Bethuel-mili kurntal. Bethuel Aram-jirri pirirri, Mespotamia-ja. Rebecca marrka Laban-ku.
PARTANYJIRRI KANYAPULINYI REBEKAH-LU (25:21-26)

Isaac-pa palinymili mirtawa punja waninyipulu palanga partanymajirri. Isaac-ju japirr marna Ngarrka, “Partany yungkuluman ngajumili mirtawa.” Pinakarrinyalu Ngarrkalu, palaja pala mirtawa ngayinykarra jarrinyi.
Kalkurnikinyipulinyi kujarra partanyjirri ngayinyja. Jinarn-jinarn pirnikinyipulu. Rebekah ngarlu kurlu waninyikinyi. Japirr marna Ngarrka, “Nganija?”

Ngarrkalu wurrarnala, “Kujarra kangkulumanpulinyi pirirrijirri. Wirtu jarrinyaja jinta pilkulinypularninyi. Jamuji karlujirrangu kurrngaljartiny yiji jarrulunypulu. Warinymilirrangu kulijarturrangu jarrulupiyi, warinymilirrangu munu. Marrkamurninymilirrangu nyampali wantulupiyijanaku murrkangunyamurninymilirranguku.”
Palaja Rebekah-lu kanyapulinyi partanyjirri, pirirrijirri.
Murrkangunyamurniny ngayarta jarrinyi pilyarripa mampuly-mampuly. Palajalu yini marnapulu Esau.
Palaja marrkamurniny ngayarta jarrinyi. Warlirnikinyi mamajimurninymili luku. Yini marnapulu Jacob. Palanga Isaac mirtanya waninyikinyi, 60 partunurrangujartiny.
PILYARRI MAYI NGANA ESAU-LU (25:27-34)
Palajirri Esau-pa Jacob wirtu jarrinyipulu, pirirri jarrinyipulu. Esau kuwiyimarta. Kuwiyiku yananyikinyi. Jacob ngatu yiji, waninyikinyi ngurranga, warrkamu jarrinyikinyalu japartumurninyku.
Esau-lu kanganyikinyalu kuwiyi japartumurninyku ngananyaku. Murrkangunyamurniny Isaac-ja ngarlungu yija yiji. Nyirtingunyamurniny pipimurninyja ngarlungu yija yiji.
Warajanga karrpungu kamparnakinyarninga mayi Jacob-ju, pilyarri mayi, pala yini lintil. Kulpanya kuwiyikartija Esau. Janparrja paliny.
Wurrarnala marrkamurninyja, “Ngaju janparr. Jinta yuwanyi pala pilyarri mayi. (Palajalu yini yinyayi wariny, Edom.)

Jacob-ju puntaju karra marnalu, “Kulakurra! Wurralapijin yija muwarr nyuntumili. Murrkangunya nyuntu. Yarti japartu ngalimili marlkarri jarrinyaja, wantulumanngalika nyampali nyuntu. Mankuluman wirtumarta wurrukarra. Ngajulu wupartumarta mankulumarna. Wurralaji ngaju wantulumarnangu mamajikapali. Palajun muwarr pinajalu, mayi yungkulumarnanta.”
Esau-lu puntaju karra marnalu, “Mayimajirrija marlkarri jarrarnili. Palaja munu mankulumarna wurrukarra, munu mamaji wantulumarnangu. Puru yiji pala. Jinta yuwanyi pala mayi!”

Jacob-ju puntaju karra marnalu, “Muwarrkurra yinkumarta yungkuluminyin. Palaja yungkulumarnanta mayi.” Esau-lu ngarlungu karra marnarningu, puru nyampaliwayiku waninyaku palinyku, karrinyikinyi wartapirti waninyaku. Muwarr yinyali, “Yuu, nyuntu wanta mamajikapali.”
Palajalu Jacob-ju martumpirripa pilyarri mayi yinyali. Palaja Esau-lu ngana, minpirni, yana.
